name: seated knee up rotation stretch
description: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
